connector.name: AFOS - Agentic Financial OS
connector.registryDescription: Agent payments over x402: pay in USDC on Base with no signup, plus trust data and hiring.
connector.summary: Hosted at focxle.com over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.focxle, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

headers.name: X-Agent-Key
headers.description: Optional. Discovery (initialize, tools/list, ping) needs no credentials, and buying over x402 needs no account at all: hold USDC on Base and pay per request. A key is only needed to call tools that spend from a platform balance, and is issued instantly at POST /api/v1/agents/self-register.
